newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Estonia Tallinn Pharma sees higher year profit.
newsitem.headline: Estonia Tallinn Pharma sees higher year profit.

text.p: Estonian drug manufacturer Tallinn Pharmaceutical said on Tuesday that its profit for the first nine months of the year was 18 million kroons and that it expected full year earnings of 23 million kroons.
It last year made a net profit of 17.2 million kroons.

The company, quoted on the over-the-counter market of the Tallinn stock exchange, said its turnover was 98.7 million kroons after the first nine months of the year. It forecast 12 months turnover of 160 to 170 million kroons.
"Tallinn Pharmaceutical has an excellent position in the Russian market," chairman Margus Linnamae said in a statement.
"As our contacts with Russian wholesalers are growing and a new factory near Moscow will soon be launched, we are forecasting an increase in sales in Russia," he added.
The company, which recently sold 10 percent of its shares to Western financial institutions, is owned by Estonia's Magnum Group.
